turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi there! How's it going today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My bike's back tire has gone flat again.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Annoying. You could patch the inner tube yourself tonight, or take it to the shop tomorrow and get a sturdier tire. What would you like to do?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Wait, Sofia needs me for a sec. Please stay quiet until I come back to you.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm here, I'm here, sorry I'm late.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: So how was the ride along the river this morning?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Beautiful, but so windy on the way back.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: All the way to the old bridge and back. My legs are dead.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Next time wake me up, I want to come.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: I tried! You told me to go away.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, fair. Set an alarm for both of us then.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey, I'm back. Sorry about that.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Alright. We were sorting out your flat tire, patching it or taking it in.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'll patch it, I've got a kit somewhere in the garage.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Great. Check the inside of the tire for a thorn first, or it'll go flat again.
